name: Tongue River — I-90 (Ranchester area)
blurb: Tongue River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Upstream of I90 (Tongue): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Take-out Downstream of I90 (Tongue): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (34.2 mi); no agency mileage found.

gaugeContext.note: The Wyoming State Engineer lists a current Tongue River station near Dayton (06298000), even though the old USGS feed is discontinued. Automated access is not connected yet; Dayton is upstream of the listed Ranchester reaches.
